notes: 'and some another' is marked added: the Greek writes only one arm of the distributive and both ἄλλοι and ἄλλο are already spent, so rule 103's repeated-quantifier case applies; rule 70 forbids treating μέν's correlative force as writing a word. Reading the phrase as licensed by μέν remains defensible.
οἱ πλείους → 'the more part' gives the determiner and the supplied nominal to the article under rule 102, headed on the nominal.
τίνος ἕνεκα → 'wherefore' is noncompositional, matching rule 45's own record of διὰ τοῦτο → 'wherefore'.
